home.title: Cooperation Platform
home.intro: A meeting place for flood-management stakeholders across the Adriatic-Ionian region: share experience in the blog, discuss in the forum, and build on the measures and documents of the URBANFLOODS KNOWBASE.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Articles, case studies and good practices from partners and members.

forum.title: Forum
forum.description: Ask questions and discuss urban flood management with peers.

knowbase.title: KNOWBASE
knowbase.description: Browse legislation, policies and flood-protection measures.

partners.intro: The organisations of the URBANFLOODS partnership will be listed here.

about.intro: Information about the Cooperation Platform and the URBANFLOODS project will be published here.
